name: 1936 Delahaye 135M Competition Coupe
note: Aerodynamic teardrop coupe with a hand-formed aluminum body on a short Delahaye 135M chassis, powered by a 4-litre six. This is my best match for the car in the photo. The Frist page doesn't give the colour, and I couldn't check the image against the car's page.
